Front: Paano gumamit ng subquery sa WHERE?
Back: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > 100);
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id);

Front: Ano ang difference ng IN at EXISTS?
Back: IN: mas mabagal sa malalaking datasets. EXISTS: mas mabilis dahil nag-stop sa unang match.
SELECT * FROM users u WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) > 5;
SELECT * FROM products WHERE price > ANY (SELECT price FROM products WHERE category = 'sale');
